typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Fact_TotalTime as string,
	G_Dw_Run_Key as integer
}
source(output(
		Total_OOO as string,
		dw_agg_key as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Total_OOO = Param_0,
		dw_agg_key = Param_1
	)) ~> OLEDBCommand1
